raw.title: Business Development Specialist
raw.excerpt: ABOUT 321 AIM321 AIM is a proprietary performance marketing platform built for businesses that need leads — not impressions.
raw.description:
ABOUT 321 AIM

321 AIM is a proprietary performance marketing platform built for businesses that need leads — not impressions. Powered by a pay-per-qualified-lead model, AIM connects clients in high-value verticals including home services, legal services, healthcare, insurance, and financial services with the ready-to-convert prospects that move the needle on revenue.

AIM operates as a distinct business unit within the 321 ecosystem, combining digital performance marketing expertise with built-in lead qualification infrastructure and transparent, outcome-based pricing. We don't sell campaigns — we sell results. And we're growing fast. Unlike traditional lead generation companies, AIM supports clients beyond lead delivery — helping ensure leads are contacted, qualified, and converted into real opportunities. This gives our clients a measurable advantage in speed-to-lead and conversion performance.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Business Development Specialist who understands how to sell performance. As AIM's dedicated sales and business development professional, you'll be responsible for identifying and closing new client partnerships across AIM's target verticals — companies that are serious about lead volume, lead quality, and measurable ROI from their marketing spend.

This isn't a traditional agency sales role. You'll be selling a performance-based model where clients pay for qualified leads, not ad spend — which means you need to understand how to speak credibly to sophisticated buyers about cost-per-lead economics, lead qualification criteria, conversion rates, and ROI. You'll build and manage your own pipeline, lead discovery through close, and serve as the face of AIM in the market.

This role requires more than selling leads — you must understand how leads turn into revenue. You will need to think beyond cost-per-lead and engage prospects in deeper conversations about conversion rates, speed-to-contact, appointment setting, and overall return on marketing investment.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Sales & New Client Acquisition

  • Develop and execute a business development strategy focused on driving new client partnerships for 321 AIM in target verticals: home services, legal services, healthcare, insurance, and financial services
  • Identify and pursue high-value prospects — including regional and national operators, franchise groups, law firms, and healthcare practices — that have strong lead volume needs and are a fit for a performance-based pricing model
  • Lead end-to-end sales cycles from prospecting and discovery through proposal, negotiation, and contract close
  • Conduct discovery conversations that uncover client lead volume goals, cost-per-lead targets, current marketing performance, and qualification criteria — and translate those into a compelling AIM partnership proposal
  • Clearly articulate AIM's value proposition, pricing model, lead qualification standards, and performance expectations to prospects, including C-suite and senior marketing decision-makers
  • Develop customized proposals that outline projected lead volume, qualified-lead definitions, pricing structure, and expected ROI
  • Maintain a disciplined sales pipeline and CRM to track prospect status, activity, and revenue projections
  • Educate prospects on the full lead lifecycle — from lead generation to contact, qualification, and appointment conversion — and position AIM as a partner across that entire funnel
  • Identify opportunities to scale lead volume, expand into additional service areas, or deepen AIM’s role in the client’s acquisition funnel

Market Development & Brand Presence

  • Build AIM's market presence within target verticals through strategic outreach, industry networking, conference participation, and partnership development
  • Identify and cultivate referral relationships with complementary vendors, franchise consultants, industry associations, and channel partners who serve AIM's target client base
  • Monitor competitor offerings, pricing models, and market positioning to ensure AIM's value proposition stays sharp and differentiated
  • Collaborate with AIM leadership to develop sales collateral, case studies, and pitch materials that demonstrate AIM's performance track record and vertical expertise
  • Represent AIM at industry events, trade shows, and vertical-specific conferences relevant to home services, legal, healthcare, insurance, and financial services
  • Diagnose breakdowns in the prospect’s current funnel (e.g., slow response times, poor follow-up, low booking rates) and position AIM as a solution not just for lead volume, but for conversion performance

Client Onboarding & Handoff

  • Serve as the primary point of contact through the pre-onboarding phase, ensuring new clients have a clear understanding of the AIM model, reporting expectations, and lead qualification process
  • Collaborate with AIM's operations and campaign management teams to ensure smooth client onboarding and alignment on qualified-lead definitions, delivery timelines, and performance benchmarks
  • Maintain strong communication during early campaign launch to support client confidence and address questions before transitioning to the ongoing account relationship
  • Identify expansion and upsell opportunities within the existing AIM client base as lead programs scale
  • Ensure alignment between what was sold and how leads will be handled — including intake process, response expectations, and appointment-setting workflows

WHAT YOU HAVE

  • 3+ years of experience in business development, sales, or client acquisition — with direct experience selling performance marketing, lead generation, or pay-per-lead programs strongly preferred
  • Deep understanding of performance-based pricing models: cost-per-lead, cost-per-acquisition, lead qualification standards, and the economics of lead generation programs
  • Proven track record of meeting and exceeding revenue and new client acquisition targets
  • Experience selling into at least one of AIM's core verticals — home services, legal services, healthcare, insurance, or financial services — is a significant plus
  • Strong command of lead generation strategy, digital media fundamentals, and the ability to speak credibly to clients about campaign mechanics, attribution, and ROI
  • Exceptional discovery and consultative selling skills — you ask the right questions, listen well, and build proposals that directly address client business goals
  • Excellent negotiation skills with the ability to navigate complex contracts, performance guarantees, and qualified-lead definition discussions
  • Proficiency in CRM platforms, pipeline management, and sales automation tools
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to develop and deliver compelling sales presentations to senior executives
  • Self-directed, entrepreneurial, and comfortable operating in a fast-growing, performance-driven environment
  • Experience selling complex or consultative solutions
  • Ability to understand and communicate full-funnel performance metrics, including lead-to-contact rate, appointment set rate, and revenue impact
  • Experience running structured discovery that uncovers both marketing and operational gaps

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • New client revenue closed (monthly/quarterly)
  • Pipeline creation and conversion rates
  • Average deal size and contract value
  • Client retention and early performance success
  • Expansion revenue from existing accounts

REPORTING STRUCTURE

The Business Development Specialist reports directly to 321 AIM leadership and works in close coordination with AIM's operations and campaign management teams. This role operates as a standalone business development function with direct visibility to senior leadership and significant influence over AIM's growth trajectory.

COMPENSATION

Structure: Competitive base salary + uncapped commission + performance-based bonuses

Compensation is structured to reward performance. Commission is uncapped and tied directly to new client revenue closed. Performance bonuses apply to volume milestones and client retention benchmarks. Top performers in this role have significant earning upside tied directly to AIM's growth. Top performers in this role have the potential to earn [optional: realistic OTE range] by consistently closing and expanding high-value client partnerships.

321 AIM BENEFITS

  • 100% remote work environment
  • Flexible scheduling with core collaboration hours
  • Paid time off + company-observed holidays
  • Health, dental, and vision benefits
  • Professional development budget and industry conference attendance
  • Direct access to AIM leadership and a fast-moving, performance-obsessed team
  • Uncapped earning potential tied to a genuinely differentiated product in a high-demand market
Salary: Competitive base salary + commission and bonuses

raw.excerpt: Who We AreRight Hook Digital is a growth marketing agency working with 7-8 figure DTC eCommerce brands across the US and Australia.
raw.description:
Who We Are

Right Hook Digital is a growth marketing agency working with 7-8 figure DTC eCommerce brands across the US and Australia. We're a Premium Google and Meta Marketing Partner, a global team of 60+, and we're scaling our US retention business.

We've partnered with brands like Alpha Lion, July Luggage, Geedup, Mister Zimi, Silly George, and many more. Our work spans paid social, Google, and retention - and we take all three seriously.

At our core, we're a team of A-Players who genuinely care about outcomes. We've built a culture around Kaizen (continuous growth), openness and candor, and elevating one another - and we look for people who live those values, not just nod at them.

The Role

We're looking for a Head of Retention to own our Retention service line end to end - the P&L, the product, the people, and the client relationships that hold it all together.

This is a business leadership role, not a senior IC role. You won't be building flows in Klaviyo. You'll be building the team that builds them, the product that makes them world-class, and the commercial engine that turns both into profitable growth.

You'll lead Group Leaders, Retention Strategists, and Specialists. You'll be the escalation point our biggest retention clients trust. And you'll own the number: gross profit growth in the Retention service line.

If you've run a service line or department before, know lifecycle marketing deeply enough to raise the standard of the work, and get real satisfaction from developing people - this is a rare seat.

What You'll Own

P&L Accountability

  • Own the Retention department's P&L and hit gross profit targets, quarter after quarter
  • Monitor department performance metrics - average client lifetime, churn, retention rates - and act early when they move the wrong way
  • Make the resourcing and pricing calls that protect margin without compromising the work

Product Excellence

  • Keep the Retention product world-class, generating genuine mutual upside for clients
  • Own "The Retention Way" - our core system - including documentation, training, SOP adherence, and the tie-breaking decisions on how it evolves
  • Push innovation in lifecycle strategy, testing, and measurement so we stay ahead of what every other agency is selling

Client Relationships

  • Build and hold strong relationships with our key retention clients, and serve as the primary escalation point when things get hard
  • Drive retention by supporting and guiding Strategists on campaigns and flows that actually move revenue
  • Proactively hunt for client feedback, aiming to WOW rather than satisfy
  • Run exit interviews with churned clients and feed what you learn back into the product

People Leadership

  • Hire, develop, and - when needed - exit talent, with a clear eye on who can make a meaningful impact on P&L growth
  • Act as an S-leader to Group Leaders, Strategists, and Specialists
  • Use our Performance and Growth Framework (PGF) to run consistent 1:1s, PGP reviews, KPI reviews, and feedback loops that people genuinely value

Growth & Operational Excellence

  • Work with our marketing team on agency campaigns, marketing materials, case studies, testimonials, and lead generation for Retention
  • Support sales conversations where your expertise closes the gap
  • Build strong relationships with our Paid Social and Google units to drive internal referrals
  • Partner with the Process Excellence Manager and COO to lift utilization, billable income, and process efficiency

Who You Are

  • You've led a retention, lifecycle, or CRM team - ideally in an agency, and ideally with P&L or revenue accountability
  • You know email and SMS deeply. You don't need to be the fastest person in Klaviyo, but you need to know world-class work from adequate work in about ten seconds, and be able to explain the difference
  • You've managed teams, not just individual contributors
  • You're commercially fluent - gross profit, utilization, retention rates and pricing are tools you use, not concepts you've heard of
  • You're comfortable being the escalation point. Hard client conversations don't rattle you
  • You give and receive candid feedback well. Our culture runs on openness, and a leader who softens everything won't work here
  • You default to systems. When something breaks twice, you fix the process, not just the instance
  • You're happy working overlapping US hours in a globally distributed team

Bonus points for: experience with 7-8 figure DTC brands, hands-on Klaviyo history, a track record building or productising a service offering, or experience supporting sales and marketing as a subject matter expert.

Why This Role

You're inheriting a real business with real clients and a team already doing good work - not a blank page and not a mess. Retention is one of three service lines we take equally seriously, which means you'll have the investment and the internal referral pipeline to grow it, plus the autonomy to shape how.

You'll report directly to our COO and sit at the table where the decisions get made.

For more than 170 years, The Hanover has been committed to delivering on our promises and being there when it matters the most. We live our values every day, demonstrating we CARE through our values, Sustainability initiatives and inclusive corporate culture.

Our Human Service Team is seeking a Senior Underwriting Specialist to add to their growing team in Central Zone.

This is a full time, exempt role either a hybrid or remote setting.

Position Overview Responsible for identifying, soliciting, underwriting and selling new and renewal Middle Market accounts that drive profitable growth and align with the Human Services Industry segment, appetite and mix goals. Apply advanced technical, sales and analytical skills to provide insurance solutions that help Hanover’s customers manage risk. Demonstrates a thorough understanding of Hanover’s strategies and Human Services appetites and will use internal and external data to make appropriate individual and portfolio Human Services risk decisions. Operates within a broad Letter of Authority for all underwriting decisions and with limited direction while managing an assigned book of business, generally with high technical complexity and coordination. Willingness to build and foster key agency relationships, identify emerging issues, obtain competitive intelligence and engage in industry-specific continuing education.

Key responsibilities Technical Underwriting

  • Knows and applies advanced underwriting concepts including risk selection, exposure and hazard identification and control, coverage implications, and loss analysis.
  • Uses all appropriate underwriting tools (e.g. RQI, WC RST, UWWS, and CLAY.), disciplines and knowledge of strategies to ensure underwriting guidelines are followed.
  • Advanced knowledge of pricing components and rating methodology and correlates pricing to exposure, financial and competitive analysis.
  • Completes file documentation according to best practices guidelines and state regulations and can clearly explain account decisions.
  • Adheres to CAT guidelines and underwriting discipline to minimize exposure and appropriately price individual risks. Applies increased knowledge of CAT aggregation to decision making.

Portfolio Management & Financial Acumen:

  • Manages assigned portfolio to achieve gross written premium, profitability, rate, retention, industry and LOB mix, new business and portfolio management goals.
  • Reviews key metrics and uncovers trends that may lead to new business opportunities with agents while achieving profitable growth in accordance with business strategies.
  • Demonstrates an understanding of the market factors and trends that can affect pricing (i.e. distribution channels, competition, organization’s growth/ profit strategy, regulation, reinsurance costs and branding).
  • Prepares or analyzes information on adverse underwriting decisions, rate appeals, underwriting requirements, status and declinations in order to drive results within the assigned territory.
  • Supports the implementation of profit improvement initiatives with key agents.

Sales Acumen & Customer Advocacy:

  • Can identify, solicit, pipeline, negotiate, and close accounts aligned with MM branch strategy. Ability to profile assigned agency plant and to strategically market our capabilities to agents.
  • Operates with a franchise perspective to identify and drive enhanced sell opportunities and create growth within other lines of business and customer segments. Utilize our value proposition to enhance agency economics, partner conversion and product specialization in partnership with local management.
  • Prioritizes and drives effective relationship management and producer activities to build trust, facilitate negotiation, and secure commitment in order to improve yield and retention ratios.
  • Keeps current on state/territory issues, regulations and trends. Utilizes market and competitor information to enhance agent relationships by becoming a trusted advisor.
  • Through stewardship process engage at the customer level for the most complex and prominent accounts within their territory.
  • Independently implements territory business plans, monitors performance, adjusts plan to ensure a substantial pipeline for future profitable growth.
  • Makes sales presentations to agents and customers on a regular basis and participants in more complex accounts:

◦ Utilize Industry Solutions partners to augment sales process through enhanced knowledge transfer, strategic producer visits/sales calls, and effective training sessions for both agents and customers. ◦ Effectively utilize Claims, Risk Solutions and Operations to display service and/or technical expertise to build confidence in customers to further secure business opportunities.

Core Competencies, Skills and Experience

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience
  • 5-7+ years Underwriting experience, with a minimum of 3 years of experience underwriting MM accounts.
  • 5+ years of experience driving agency relationships resulting in profitable new and renewal business.
  • May specialize /certify in one or more Industry Segments.
  • Acts as a change advocate, and is open to new and different ways of thinking.
  • Communication (verbal and written) - Interacts and communicates with confidence with all levels of external and/or internal business partners within scope of responsibility, team and/or matrix environment. Can judge appropriate means and method to communicate based on the nature of the communication. Able to influence desired outcomes to drive actions and results. Adept at influencing even when holding a position contrary to the majority opinion.
  • Judgement and Decision Making - Ability to exercise judgment, negotiate and make sound business decisions based on level of authority. Applies judgment and expertise to determine when escalation is needed. Demonstrates confidence in one’s ability to apply decision making to UW assessment.
  • Agile and Adaptive - Strong ability to identify, analyze and solve problems as well as the ability to learn rapidly, adapt quickly to change, exercise influence, and manage and prioritize multiple concurrent projects.
  • Team work and Collaboration – Consistently fosters collaboration and respect among team members. Easily adapts to the diverse interests, styles and perspective of key players. Is able to engage multiple members of a group to share information and to consider other points of view to reach objectives, consensus and/or deadlines.
  • Experienced in working with a wide range of teams and readily shares lessons learned.
  • Informal Leadership - Viewed as an informal leader amongst the team/branch/region/LOB. Open to and proactively shares knowledge and expertise with peers, management and leadership. Acts as a mentor for less experienced underwriters or newly hired underwriters, may assist with training other team members. Is used as a resource by others to collaborate on more complex risks, pricing, trends, industry segments coverages and product knowledge. May conduct peer-to-peer self-audits under the direction of management.

It’s not just a job, it’s a career, and we are here to support you every step of the way. We want you to be successful and fulfilled. Through on-the-job experiences, personalized coaching and our robust learning and development programs, we encourage you – at every level – to grow and develop.

raw.description:
About the Role

IAA is seeking a Principal Data Engineer to serve as the most senior individual contributor and technical authority across our data engineering function. This is a hands-on, deeply technical leadership role for an engineer who sets architectural direction, raises the engineering bar, and personally builds the most complex and business-critical components of IAA’s data platform.

Where the Director leads through people and strategy, the Principal Data Engineer leads through technical depth, influence, and execution. This person defines patterns and standards, solves the hardest data engineering problems, and acts as a force multiplier for engineers across the organization. They ensure IAA’s data platform is scalable, reliable, secure, and ready to power advanced analytics, BI, forecasting, and the data needs of AI solutions.

This is a high-visibility role that partners closely with engineering leadership, data scientists, BI developers, platform/infrastructure teams, and business stakeholders across Operations, Sales, Marketing, and Product.

What You’ll Do

  • Set and evolve the technical architecture for IAA’s data platform — ingestion, transformation, storage, semantic modeling, and data delivery — on the Azure data and analytics stack.
  • Personally design and build the most complex, high-impact data pipelines, frameworks, and reusable components that other engineers build upon.
  • Define engineering standards and patterns across architecture, code quality, performance, scalability, observability, and governance — and drive their adoption through example and mentorship.
  • Lead the design and implementation of robust pipelines, semantic models, and data products that power dashboards, self-service analytics, forecasting, and downstream machine learning systems.
  • Build the production-grade data pipelines and feature/data infrastructure that data scientists rely on to train, serve, and operationalize models.
  • Diagnose and resolve the toughest performance, reliability, and scalability challenges across BI and data workloads (e.g., Power BI, Synapse, Fabric).
  • Drive technical strategy and execution across Microsoft Fabric, Synapse, Power BI, and broader Azure BI technologies, evaluating new tools and making build/buy recommendations.
  • Mentor and grow data engineers and analytics engineers, conducting design reviews and elevating the technical capability of the team.
  • Act as a senior technical thought partner to engineering and business leadership on data architecture, technical tradeoffs, and platform investment priorities.
  • Translate complex business problems into practical, scalable, and well-architected data solutions.

What We’re Looking For

  • Extensive hands-on experience as a senior or principal-level data engineer, with a track record of designing and building production data platforms at scale.
  • Deep expertise across the Azure BI / data technology stack, including:
    • Microsoft Fabric
    • Azure Synapse Analytics
    • Power BI and semantic modeling
    • Broader Azure data and analytics services
  • Strong command of data engineering architecture, modern analytics platforms, dimensional and semantic modeling, and scalable, fault-tolerant pipelines.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Python and SQL, with strong software engineering fundamentals (testing, version control, CI/CD, modular design).
  • Working understanding of how data scientists consume data, enough to build the pipelines and feature/data infrastructure that support model training and serving.
  • Demonstrated ability to solve ambiguous, complex business problems through robust technical design and pragmatic execution.
  • Strong mentoring and influence skills — able to elevate engineering practices and lead technically without formal authority.
  • Excellent communication skills; able to explain complex technical concepts and tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical partners across Ops, Business, Sales, Marketing, Product, and Engineering.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-visibility environment with multiple priorities and stakeholders.

Preferred Experience

  • 12+ years experience building data platforms supporting enterprise use cases across operations, commercial functions, and product-driven organizations.
  • Experience spanning both BI modernization and data platform enablement for analytics and ML within the same platform.
  • Familiarity with cloud-native engineering practices, infrastructure-as-code, and secure, scalable data environments.
  • Experience defining platform-wide standards and reference architectures adopted across multiple teams.
  • Experience building data pipelines that support RAG, LLM, or modern AI workloads on enterprise data.

Why This Role Matters

The Principal Data Engineer is the technical anchor of IAA’s data and AI capability. This person shapes how the company builds and scales its data platform — enabling better decisions, improved business performance, operational efficiencies, and a durable competitive advantage. Through architecture, hands-on engineering, and influence, this leader directly impacts both technical direction and business outcomes across the organization.

Summary

SafetyChain Software is looking for a Senior Business Development Representative (BDR) to join our Sales team.This is a senior/tenured position within our BDR team. In addition to core pipeline generation, this person will take on an informal team lead role, surfacing team progress and blockers to the BDR Manager, helping keep the broader team aligned, while still carrying a full individual quota.

We're building a team that operates at the cutting edge, our BDRs are expected to actively use AI tools to research accounts, build better outreach, and find creative ways to generate pipeline faster. If you've figured out how to use AI to work smarter and do more, you'll fit right in here.

About Us:

SafetyChain is a rapidly scaling B2B SaaS provider revolutionizing plant management for Food and Beverage manufacturers by improving yield, maximizing productivity, and ensuring compliance. Our impressive client base includes renowned brands like Albertsons, Clif Bar, Tyson Foods, and Whole Foods. Join a dynamic, collaborative team driven by innovation, agility, and rapid growth.

We are a remote-first company. While this role is primarily remote, there may be occasional opportunities to collaborate in person for quarterly business reviews, team training, or customer visits. This is completely optional and flexible based on your location and preferences.

Key Responsibilities:

The Senior Business Development Representative (BDR) will play a critical role in moving prospective buyers through the sales funnel. You will engage with inbound leads—primarily Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs)—as well as manage recycled leads and re-engagement opportunities. Your focus will be to qualify prospects, nurture early interest, and set high-quality appointments for our Account Executives.

Team Lead Support: act as a point of contact between the BDR team and BDR Manager, surfacing activity trends, blockers, and wins Mentorship: help onboard and coach newer BDRs on process, tools, and best practices

  • Lead Engagement
  • Lead Management
  • Qualification
  • Own small projects that support pipeline generation
  • Relationship Building
  • Top-of-Funnel Excellence
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Problem Solving
  • Continuous Learning

Performance Expectations

  • Activity Targets: Approximately 40–50 outreach activities (calls, emails, LinkedIn touches) per day.
  • SQL Goal: Aim to generate 12–16 qualified sales opportunities per month.
  • Speed-to-Lead: Initial outreach to inbound leads within 24 hours.
  • We’ll provide the tools, training, and support to help you hit these numbers confidently.

Qualifications:

  • Have 2+ years of BDR/SDR or equivalent sales development experience, with a demonstrated track record of hitting or exceeding quota, preferably within the B2B/Saas or enterprise software industry.
  • Comfortable taking on informal leadership responsibilities — communicating team progress to management and supporting teammates without formal authority.
  • Willing to experiment with new tools and approaches to find what generates pipeline.
  • Comfortable experimenting with AI tools to improve outreach quality and efficiency
  • Have strong organizational and time management skills—you can keep moving even when managing a high volume of leads.
  • Are a self-starter who’s motivated to succeed in sales and open to feedback along the way.
  • Communicate clearly, listen actively, and can build rapport with all kinds of people.
  • Are comfortable learning and using tools like Sales Navigator, HubSpot, and other tools.
  • Are a natural problem solver who stays proactive and focuses on results.
  • Are eager to learn, grow, multi-task, and take on new challenges. We invest in our people.
  • Experience informally leading, mentoring, or supporting peers is a plus.

Growth Path: This role is designed as a stepping stone. High performers can expect a path into a full-time BDR Manager or Account Executive role within 12-18 months.

Why Join Us?

At SafetyChain Solutions, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being and professional growth:

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance plans to keep you and your family healthy.
  • Retirement Planning: A 401(k) plan with company matching to help you save for the future.
  • Work-Life Balance: Unlimited paid time off (PTO) and holidays to ensure you have time to recharge.
  • Professional Development: Opportunities for continuous learning, including access to training resources, workshops, and conferences.
  • Flexible Work Environment: Fully Remote with a generous monthly home office payment.
  • Employee Engagement: Regular team-building activities, company events, and an inclusive work culture that values diversity and collaboration.

Personal Attributes We Value

  • Experimentalism: you're willing to test new tools, sequences, and tactics without needing perfect conditions to get started. You learn by doing, debrief honestly, and apply it fast.
  • Initiative: you are a scrappy, self-motivated go-getter with the ability to accept and incorporate coaching and feedback.
  • Collaborative: you seek opportunities to learn from others, solicit honest feedback and always have the best interests of the team and our customers in mind.
  • Inquisitiveness: a desire to expand your knowledge base and explore concepts and ideas that are new and unfamiliar.
  • Process Driven: you are highly structured, disciplined and organized in creating and executing operational processes to ensure a consistent, repeatable outcome.
  • Integrity: you do what you say you will do and don’t let your colleagues or customers down.
  • Patience: the ability to adapt to changing situations while remaining calm, collected, and committed.
  • Self-improvement: the ability to identify mistakes and quickly adjust approach when confronted with new information or perspective.

Salary: up to 100k OTE, d.o.e. (Base + Commission)

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Cold Email Outreach Specialist to generate qualified sales opportunities through strategic outbound email campaigns.

This is a hands-on, performance-driven role where you’ll own the entire cold email process—from building targeted prospect lists and writing personalized outreach to managing deliverability, optimizing campaigns, and qualifying inbound responses.

Success in this role comes from combining strong copywriting, technical deliverability knowledge, and a data-driven approach to consistently generate qualified pipeline for the sales team.

If you’re passionate about outbound prospecting, enjoy experimenting with messaging, and understand what it takes to keep campaigns landing in inboxes—not spam folders—this role is for you.

Prospect Research & List Building

    • Apollo
    • ZoomInfo
    • LinkedIn Sales Navigator
    • Crunchbase
    • Similar prospecting platforms

    • Industry
    • Company size
    • Job title
    • Geography
    • Ideal Customer Profile (ICP)

    • NeverBounce
    • ZeroBounce
    • Clearout

Cold Email Campaign Management

  • Write personalized cold email copy, subject lines, and calls-to-action.
  • Build and launch multi-step outbound sequences (4–8 touchpoints).
  • Personalize messaging using company and prospect research.
  • Monitor campaign performance daily.
  • Continuously optimize campaigns based on engagement and reply metrics.

Deliverability & Inbox Management

  • Manage inbox reputation using platforms such as:
    • Instantly
    • Lemlist
    • Smartlead
    • Mailwarm
  • Monitor:
    • Bounce rates
    • Spam scores
    • Sender reputation
    • Inbox health
  • Rotate sending domains and inboxes to maximize deliverability.
  • Identify and resolve deliverability issues before campaign performance declines.

Campaign Optimization & Reporting

  • Conduct A/B testing on:
    • Subject lines
    • Messaging
    • CTAs
    • Send times
  • Track key metrics including:
    • Open rates
    • Positive reply rates
    • Bounce rates
    • Conversion rates
  • Prepare campaign performance reports and recommend improvements.
  • Document testing results and optimization history.

Lead Qualification & CRM Management

  • Review campaign replies and categorize responses accurately.
  • Identify qualified prospects and route them to the sales team.
  • Maintain accurate CRM records using:
    • HubSpot
    • Salesforce
    • Zoho CRM
    • Similar CRM platforms
  • Ensure outreach data remains organized and up to date.

Compliance & Best Practices

  • Ensure campaigns comply with:
    • CAN-SPAM
    • GDPR
    • CCPA
  • Maintain suppression and unsubscribe lists.
  • Follow outbound email best practices to protect sender reputation.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • Excellent persuasive and concise writing skills.
  • Strong analytical mindset with a focus on performance improvement.
  • Comfortable using outbound automation and deliverability tools.
  • Organized, proactive, and highly execution-focused.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Continuously tests, learns, and optimizes campaign performance.

Required Experience & Skills

Experience

  • 1–2+ years of experience in:
    • Cold Email Outreach
    • Outbound Lead Generation
    • Sales Development (SDR)
    • Outbound Marketing

Technical Skills

  • Hands-on experience with:
    • Apollo
    • Instantly
    • Lemlist
    • Smartlead
    • Woodpecker
    • Similar outreach platforms
  • Experience writing cold email campaigns.
  • Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills.
  • Excellent written English communication.

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience managing large-scale email deliverability.
  • Understanding of:
    • DNS
    • SPF
    • DKIM
    • DMARC
  • Experience supporting B2B SaaS, agencies, or service businesses.
  • Experience collaborating with SDRs or Account Executives.
  • Familiarity with outbound automation workflows and CRM integrations.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Build and refine prospect lists.
  • Launch and monitor outbound email campaigns.
  • Review inbox health and deliverability metrics.
  • Optimize messaging, targeting, and campaign performance.
  • Qualify interested prospects and hand them off to sales.
  • Update CRM records and maintain campaign documentation.

In short: You own outbound email execution—from research and personalization to optimization and lead qualification—ensuring a consistent flow of qualified opportunities into the sales pipeline.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • High email open rates.
  • Positive reply and conversation rates.
  • Low bounce rates and strong inbox health.
  • Consistent campaign execution and optimization.
  • Accurate CRM documentation.
  • Growth in qualified outbound pipeline.

Why Join Us?

  • Own the complete outbound email process from strategy to execution.
  • Work with modern sales engagement and automation tools.
  • Directly influence pipeline growth and revenue generation.
  • Performance-driven environment with measurable impact.
  • Opportunities to grow into:
    • Senior Outbound Specialist
    • Sales Development Team Lead
    • Outbound Growth Manager
    • Revenue Operations

Interview Process

  1. Initial Phone Screen
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)
  3. Recruiter Interview
  4. Practical Assessment (Cold Email Sequence Exercise)
  5. Client Interview
  6. Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the next step that completes your application and can be recorded whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. This helps the hiring team evaluate your communication style early, making future interviews more meaningful while reducing unnecessary interview rounds.

Don’t overthink it—you can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after submitting your application.

Apply Now

If you’re passionate about outbound prospecting, enjoy writing high-performing cold emails, understand email deliverability, and want to help generate qualified sales opportunities through data-driven outreach, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and become a key contributor to building a predictable outbound pipeline.

raw.description:
As a Strategic Account Manager – Multi-Family, you will help grow Moen's Multi-Family business by building strategic partnerships with leading ownership groups, management companies, general contractors, and preferred distribution partners across the apartment, student housing, senior living, military housing, and single-family rental markets. You'll strengthen existing partnerships while identifying new opportunities to increase product specifications, expand market share, and position Moen solutions within high-profile new construction, renovation, and replacement projects.

In this collaborative, customer-focused role, you'll serve as a trusted strategic partner to some of the industry's most recognized organizations. Working closely with internal sales teams, channel partners, marketing, and product leadership, you'll help shape national Multi-Family growth strategies, influence key project decisions from specification through completion, and create long-term value for both Moen and our customers.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys developing executive-level relationships, navigating complex sales cycles, and collaborating across multiple teams to achieve shared goals. You'll combine strategic thinking with strong project management skills to identify growth opportunities, build trusted relationships with executive-level decision makers, and help strengthen Moen's long-term position within the Multi-Family market.

We value individuals who can Think Fast by identifying opportunities and solving customer challenges; Work It Together by building trusted partnerships across teams and customers; and Make the Hard Call by making thoughtful decisions that create long-term value.

POSITION LOCATION: Candidates located within the Central or Western United States are preferred, with a preference for those based near Chicago, Atlanta, Washington, DC, the San Francisco Bay Area, Houston, or San Antonio, TX. Candidates should also have convenient access to a major airport to effectively support customer engagement and travel requirements. Internal FBIN candidates outside of these preferred markets are encouraged to apply.

This role requires up to 70% travel, including approximately 3 to 4 overnight trips per month. A company expense card is provided for approved travel-related expenses.

What you will be doing

  • Build, strengthen, and expand strategic relationships with leading ownership groups, management companies, general contractors, and preferred distribution partners across the Multi-Family market.
  • Increase product specifications and expand market share by promoting Moen's portfolio of solutions across targeted ownership groups, strategic accounts, and key project opportunities.
  • Support the development and execution of strategic growth plans for assigned national accounts by identifying emerging opportunities, expanding customer relationships, and increasing Moen's presence across the Multi-Family market.
  • Guide high-profile new construction, renovation, and replacement projects from specification through completion, partnering with internal teams and external stakeholders to support successful project execution.
  • Partner with Marketing, Product Management, Channel Marketing, and Sales leadership to help shape strategic initiatives that support long-term Multi-Family growth.
  • Collaborate with regional sales teams, Business Development Managers, and National Sales leaders to advance Multi-Family opportunities and increase project conversion.
  • Partner with the field sales organization by sharing best practices, project opportunities, and customer strategies that help increase project conversion and strengthen customer relationships.
  • Represent Moen at industry trade shows, Multi-Family conferences, networking events, and customer meetings to strengthen relationships and cultivate new opportunities.
  • Monitor market trends, competitive activity, customer insights, and industry developments while providing insights and recommendations that help inform future business strategies.
  • Utilize travel, promotional, and business development budgets responsibly to maximize customer engagement and return on investment.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 5+ years of progressive sales experience with a demonstrated track record of achieving business objectives and building strategic customer relationships.
  • Experience managing national or regional strategic accounts within the Multi-Family, commercial construction, building products, or related industries.
  • Experience developing long-term strategic partnerships that create mutual business value and customer growth.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence executive-level stakeholders and navigate complex, multi-stakeholder sales environments.
  • Strong relationship-building, networking, and communication skills with the ability to engage and influence stakeholders at all organizational levels.
  • Strategic thinker with strong problem-solving skills and a consultative approach to customer engagement.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex projects involving multiple internal and external stakeholders.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across cross-functional teams.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and CRM platforms.
  • Ability to travel up to 70%, including approximately 3 to 4 overnight trips per month.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience working within the Multi-Family industry, including apartment, student housing, senior living, military housing, single-family rental, or related commercial construction segments.
  • Experience selling plumbing, kitchen and bath, building materials, or other specification-driven commercial products.
  • Experience collaborating with architects, designers, ownership groups, distributors, general contractors, or commercial construction professionals.
  • Knowledge of specification processes and commercial construction project cycles.
  • Experience leading strategic customer initiatives or serving as a trusted advisor to national Multi-Family organizations.

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Business Applications Developer to design, build, and maintain business applications, automation workflows, and business intelligence solutions using the Microsoft 365 and Power Platform ecosystem.

This is a hands-on development role where you’ll transform manual business processes into scalable digital solutions through automation, reporting, and system integrations. You’ll work closely with business stakeholders to build applications, dashboards, and workflows that improve operational efficiency and provide actionable business insights.

If you enjoy solving business challenges through automation, building intelligent workflows, and leveraging modern Microsoft technologies, this role is an excellent fit.

What You’ll Own

Power BI & Business Intelligence

  • Design and develop interactive Power BI dashboards and reports.
  • Build scalable data models using:
    • DAX
    • Power Query
  • Translate business data into meaningful operational insights.
  • Optimize dashboard performance, usability, and reporting accuracy.
  • Support executive and operational reporting initiatives.

Power Platform Development

  • Develop automated workflows using Power Automate.
  • Build internal business applications with Power Apps.
  • Create approval workflows, automation processes, and custom connectors.
  • Design scalable solutions aligned with business objectives.
  • Continuously improve and maintain existing Power Platform applications.

Azure & Systems Integration

  • Build integrations using:
    • Azure Functions
    • REST APIs
    • Webhooks
    • Custom services
  • Connect Microsoft 365 applications with third-party platforms.
  • Develop secure and reliable automation pipelines.
  • Troubleshoot integration and workflow issues.

Microsoft Teams & AI Solutions

  • Develop Microsoft Teams applications and integrations.
  • Build bots and adaptive cards.
  • Work with Microsoft Copilot Studio to create AI-powered workflows and agents.
  • Enhance collaboration across the Microsoft ecosystem.

Security, Governance & Optimization

  • Follow Microsoft security and governance best practices.
  • Ensure applications remain secure, scalable, and reliable.
  • Monitor workflow performance and optimize automation efficiency.
  • Support compliance and access management requirements.

Collaboration & Documentation

  • Gather business requirements from stakeholders.
  • Translate operational needs into technical solutions.
  • Maintain technical documentation and workflow diagrams.
  • Provide user training and ongoing support when needed.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • Analytical problem-solver with a passion for automation.
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.
  • Strong communicator who can collaborate with both technical and business stakeholders.
  • Detail-oriented with a focus on scalability, usability, and performance.
  • Passionate about Microsoft technologies, automation, and business intelligence.

Required Experience & Skills

Experience

  • 2–4 years of experience developing solutions using Microsoft technologies.

Technical Skills

  • Strong Power BI experience, including:
    • DAX
    • Power Query
    • Data modeling
    • Dashboard development
  • Advanced Power Automate experience, including complex workflows and custom connectors.
  • Hands-on experience with Azure services and Azure Functions.
  • Strong JavaScript and/or TypeScript skills.
  • Experience with:
    • REST APIs
    • Webhooks
    • Third-party integrations
  • Strong understanding of:
    • Microsoft 365
    • SharePoint development
    • Business intelligence concepts

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience building enterprise automation solutions.
  • Familiarity with:
    • Microsoft Copilot Studio
    • Dataverse
    • SharePoint Lists
    • Microsoft Graph API
  • Knowledge of Microsoft governance, compliance, and security.
  • Experience automating workflows across:
    • Operations
    • Finance
    • HR
    • Sales

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Build and optimize Power BI dashboards.
  • Develop and troubleshoot Power Automate workflows.
  • Create internal applications using Power Apps.
  • Develop Azure integrations and APIs.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to improve operational processes.
  • Maintain technical documentation and optimize existing solutions.

In short: You build intelligent business applications, automate operational workflows, and deliver reporting solutions that help teams work more efficiently and make better decisions.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Number of business processes successfully automated.
  • Workflow reliability and uptime.
  • Dashboard adoption and reporting accuracy.
  • Reduction in manual operational effort.
  • Stakeholder satisfaction with automation solutions.
  • Application performance, scalability, and maintainability.

Why Join Us?

  • Fully remote position aligned with EST business hours.
  • Work with modern Microsoft technologies including:
    • Power BI
    • Power Apps
    • Power Automate
    • Azure
    • Microsoft 365
    • Copilot Studio
  • Build high-impact automation and business intelligence solutions.
  • Collaborate directly with business stakeholders and leadership.
  • Career growth opportunities into:
    • Senior Business Applications Developer
    • Power Platform Architect
    • Solutions Architect
    • Enterprise Automation Lead
    • Business Intelligence Manager

Interview Process

  1. Initial Phone Screen
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)
  3. Recruiter Interview
  4. Technical Assessment or Workflow Exercise
  5. Client Interview
  6. Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the next step that completes your application and can be recorded whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. This helps the hiring team evaluate your communication style early, making future interviews more meaningful while reducing unnecessary interview rounds.

Don’t overthink it—you can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after submitting your application.

Apply Now

If you’re passionate about building business applications, automating workflows, creating impactful Power BI dashboards, and leveraging the Microsoft ecosystem to solve real business problems, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and help drive operational efficiency through intelligent automation and business intelligence.

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an Inbound Marketer to build scalable inbound marketing systems that generate qualified pipeline through content, SEO, and conversion optimization.

This is far more than a traditional SEO role.

You’ll create high-quality content, improve search visibility, develop lead magnets, optimize conversion paths, and distribute content across the right channels to drive awareness, demand, and measurable business growth.

You’ll work closely with leadership and marketing teams to build inbound engines that turn content into qualified leads—not just traffic.

If you understand how search, content, buyer psychology, and conversion work together, and enjoy creating marketing assets that generate real business results, this role is a strong fit.

Research & Content Strategy

Analytics & Optimization

What Success Looks Like

  • Higher organic search visibility and rankings.

  • High-performing, valuable content assets.
  • Strong contribution to pipeline from inbound channels.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You understand that inbound marketing creates demand—not just content.
  • You write content that educates, engages, and converts.

Required Experience & Skills

Experience

    • Inbound Marketing

  • Strong understanding of:
    • SEO
    • Search intent
    • Inbound funnel strategy
  • Experience using:
    • Google Search Console

    • SEMrush

  • Excellent written English and storytelling skills.
  • Experience creating conversion-focused marketing content.
  • Strong research and analytical abilities.

Nice to Have

  • Agency or B2B marketing experience.
  • Experience building and promoting lead magnets.
  • Familiarity with LinkedIn content distribution.
  • Understanding of AI-powered search optimization.
  • Experience improving website conversion rates and inbound lead generation.

Tech Stack

  • Google Analytics 4 (GA4)
  • Google Search Console
  • SEMrush
  • Ahrefs
  • LinkedIn
  • ChatGPT
  • AI Writing & Research Tools

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Write and optimize blogs, landing pages, and website content.
  • Research search trends, competitors, and keyword opportunities.
  • Build lead magnets and conversion-focused assets.
  • Review SEO and content performance data.
  • Optimize existing content based on rankings and analytics.
  • Collaborate with marketing teams on inbound campaigns.
  • Improve inbound funnels and content distribution strategies.

In short: You’ll build inbound marketing systems that turn valuable content, search visibility, and conversion optimization into qualified pipeline and measurable business growth.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Growth in organic traffic.
  • Qualified inbound leads generated.
  • Improved keyword rankings and search visibility.
  • Landing page and lead magnet conversion rates.
  • Engagement and performance of inbound content.
  • Pipeline contribution from inbound marketing.

Why This Role Stands Out

    • SEO
    • Content Marketing
    • AI Search Optimization
    • Lead Generation
    • Conversion Optimization

  • Career progression into:
    • Senior Inbound Marketer
    • Content Marketing Manager
    • SEO Manager
    • Demand Generation Manager

Interview Process

  1. Application Review
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)

What Happens After You Apply

After submitting your application, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record a short 3–5 minute Intro Video. This is the first step in our hiring process and can be completed whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of multiple initial screening calls, you’ll have one opportunity to introduce yourself, discuss your experience with inbound marketing, SEO, content creation, lead generation, and conversion optimization. You’ll also have the opportunity to highlight campaigns you’ve worked on, how you’ve improved organic growth, and how you’ve used AI tools to enhance content creation, research, and marketing workflows. Your video will be reviewed by the hiring team before moving to the practical assessment and client interview.

You can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it—only your final version will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after applying.

Apply Now

If you’re passionate about building inbound marketing systems, creating high-impact content, and turning search traffic into qualified pipeline, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and help drive measurable business growth through modern inbound marketing.

About the Role

Drug Hunter is a B2B scientific intelligence platform for biotech/pharma R&D scientists that empowers them to discover the medicines of the future. We serve most of the top global biotech & pharma companies including Dow 30 and S&P500 companies. We're a mission-driven, product-focused company backed by top-tier investors and trusted by the world's leading R&D organizations.

We are looking for a life science Senior Marketing Manager to turn Drug Hunter's positioning into programs that move the business — account-based and lifecycle campaigns, product launches, sales enablement, and the customer proof behind our claims. Reporting to the Director of Marketing, you'll work closely with our Science, Sales, and Head of Marketing to deliver and apply our messaging, and translate customer and market learnings into messaging that you put in market.

This is a hands-on, individual contributor role for an experienced marketer who likes to develop new strategic initiatives and execute across a broad surface area.

Key Responsibilities

Account-based & lifecycle programs

  • Develop and deploy ABM campaigns with tailored messaging, content, and CTAs
  • Deliver our positioning within lifecycle programs with appropriate messaging for the intended audience at their stage in the customer journey
  • Partner with Sales to maintain our segmented target account list, and design the approach for each segment type
  • Ensure tracking mechanism is established for each program to monitor progress, measure success, and build a playbook for future ABM & lifecycle programs

Product launch

  • Develop and drive our go-to-market for new platform capabilities: audience, narrative, launch assets, and sales readiness
  • Orchestrate product marketing initiatives and provide direction to all cross-functional teams involved
  • Partner with Marketing leadership, Science, and Sales to land the positioning and narrative for each launch
  • Establish post-launch activities to drive adoption ensuring optimized ongoing communication with current customer base
  • Create reports in HubSpot to track launch success and areas for improvement on future launches

Sales enablement

  • Leverage voice of customer and voice of sales to iteratively revise sales collateral including pitch decks, one-pagers, feature decks, demo & site visit collateral, and any leave-behind content needed
  • Develop customer proof with the Sales and Science teams including case studies, customer stories, use cases, and user tips to provoke intrigue in the product

Messaging

  • Take voice of customer, market learnings, voice of sales, and Science team insights to create new marketing messaging to put in market and test
  • Design and execute product marketing experiments for message, CTA, format, and audience variables and define what each one is meant to prove
  • Establish parameters to track, measure, and report on tests, running a steady cadence of experiments in market to create a new baseline messaging strategy for the following year

Requirements

Qualifications

  • College degree required (B.S. or M.S. in science a plus)
  • 5–8 years in marketing (product, content, and/or growth marketing). Prior experience marketing to a pharma/biotech audience at a Life Science B2B company required. SaaS experience a plus.
  • Exceptional writing and attention to detail. You can communicate to a technical audience and you understand why credibility is crucial in scientific marketing
  • Demonstrated case study or customer story portfolio
  • Experience building sales enablement assets for a considered, multi-stakeholder enterprise sale
  • Comfort working directly with scientists and technical subject matter experts
  • Account-based marketing experience preferred; HubSpot familiarity is a plus
  • Travel up to 20%

Benefits

Drug Hunter provides industry-leading benefits, including the following:

  • Competitive salary, variable compensation, and equity
  • Broad range of medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans for employees and their dependents, including generous coverage for a platinum PPO healthcare plan
  • Short-term disability and long-term disability insurance
  • Cancer and critical illness coverage
  • Up to 14 weeks paid parental leave (after 1 yr tenure) and childcare FSA plan
  • 401(k) + employer match (3-5%)
  • Home office set up stipend for fully remote employees
  • Learning and development support
  • Generous and flexible vacation and leave policies

Renew Home is on a mission to change how we power the world by making it easier for customers to save energy and money at home as part of the largest residential virtual power plant in North America.

We partner with industry-leading brands to better manage residential energy for users by prioritizing efficiency, savings, and comfort — and cleaner energy for everyone.

We strongly encourage candidates to check out our website at to learn more about the world-changing work we are doing.

Role Summary

Renew Home is seeking a Sales Director, Utility Partnerships, to drive new business growth with utilities across North America. This is an individual contributor role designed for a proven dealmaker who thrives in complex enterprise sales environments and knows how to turn emerging markets into closed contracts. The role involves travel (approximately 15% or more) to engage directly with utility partners, attend industry events, and build relationships across the energy ecosystem.

Renew Home is building the largest residential virtual power plant in North America, enabling utilities to unlock flexible grid capacity from connected homes. Our platform aggregates devices to deliver reliable, dispatchable capacity that supports grid reliability and accelerates decarbonization.

This role is for someone who is energized by identifying new opportunities, building momentum with customers, and helping shape how new solutions come to market. You will be responsible for identifying opportunities, building executive relationships, shaping programs with utilities, and ultimately closing long-term partnerships that deploy grid-flexibility solutions at scale.

The ideal candidate brings a deep understanding of the utility industry, distributed energy resources, and demand-side programs, along with a demonstrated ability to navigate complex regulatory and stakeholder environments to close multi-year deals.

What Success Looks Like

  • Building a strong pipeline of qualified utility opportunities.
  • Converting strategic partnerships into utility contracts.
  • Helping position Renew Home as a foundational platform for residential VPPs.
  • Expanding the adoption of flexible resources as a core grid reliability solution.

What You Will Do

Own and Close Strategic Utility Deals

Develop, advance, and close complex enterprise partnerships with utilities. Own the entire sales lifecycle—from opportunity creation and early stakeholder engagement through proposal development, contract negotiation, and deal closure.

Create and Drive Pipeline

Build and maintain a robust pipeline of qualified opportunities across utilities. This role requires a proactive hunter mentality: identifying whitespace, creating urgency, and converting interest into executed agreements.

Market Creation & Strategic Positioning

Help utilities understand the value of residential virtual power plants and flexible load resources. Translate emerging grid challenges—capacity constraints, electrification, reliability needs—into actionable opportunities for Renew Home solutions.

Executive Relationship Building

raw.description:
Head of Growth Marketing

Jobstream™ · Career Creator Network™

Reports to: Katie Fortunato, Co-Founder & President Direct Reports: Creator Community & Growth Manager
Position Type: Full-time (temp-to-perm), or 3-month contract to FTE

Compensation: $120k-$170k + bonus

Location: US-based, remote. Open to US travel as needed, estimate about quarterly

About Jobstream™

Jobstream™ is defining a new category at the intersection of the creator economy and talent discovery. We are the first Career Creator network, enabling creators to earn income by helping their audiences discover real jobs. Everything runs through the Career Creator Network™, our community of career creators growing together.

Backed by 25+ years of human capital infrastructure through Hire Innovations, we operate with startup speed and enterprise support. You will report into the Co-Founder and President and be considered part of the founding team. This next year is about going to market, and you will be at the center of it.

We build for the visual world. We show instead of tell. We protect what is human in the job search. And the brand can never fail.

Role Overview

The Head of Growth Marketing owns two sides of the same flywheel: the creator network and the enterprise brand campaigns it powers. Client delivery and fulfillment succeed end to end when creators are thriving, engaged, and earning. That flywheel is yours.

On one side, you own the growth engine: the profile of the brand, creator acquisition across every persona, and the health of the community everything depends on. On the other, you make sure that engine delivers. The team owns campaign execution; you hold them accountable to it, ensuring the community and growth systems work as one flywheel so that when a client campaign needs the network, the network is ready.

You bring proven growth playbooks from ecommerce and digital businesses and apply them to a new category-defining creator platform. Creator monetization runs on these mechanics: conversion funnels, performance data, retention loops, and brand partnerships that renew because they work.

This is a doer's role first and a leader's role second. Our philosophy is simple: we build the systems ourselves, then hire for what we can't do. You architect the playbook and you run it, hands on, and direct and grow the growth marketing function. Your first direct report is the Creator Community & Growth Manager, a creator-native operator who serves as the day-to-day, peer-level face of the community. You set the strategy, priorities, and standard; they bring the lived growth by community credibility. Together you cover the full picture. The leadership path here is earned through building. Stage one: you do the work and build the systems. Stage two: you document the playbooks and delegate what is repeatable. Stage three: you own the full growth function, with a team you shaped across creator acquisition and campaign delivery, and scope that expands as the systems you built prove out. You are creating the standard of excellence from the onset, and the function grows around it.

What You Own

1. Team Leadership

  • Manage the Creator Community & Growth Manager, social media, content functions aligned towards the same: weekly priorities, clear goals, accountability, coaching, and development
  • Lead as a player-coach: build the systems and run the work alongside your team, then delegate what is documented and repeatable
  • Build the operating rhythm for the growth team: briefs, reviews, reporting, and a documented playbook that scales as the team grows
  • Hire and onboard future team members or vendors across creator acquisition and campaign delivery as the function expands
  • Grow into full ownership of the growth function: as the systems you build prove out, your scope, decision rights, and team expand with them

2. Brand Profile & Visibility

  • Grow the public profile of Jobstream™ and the Career Creator Network™ across every channel and every brand moment
  • Lead brand storytelling built for the visual world: social first, video first, show over tell, designed to attract an elite group of career creators
  • Own brand standards across all touchpoints, holding every asset, campaign, and activation to the highest bar
  • Drive IRL brand activations end to end, and convert every moment into pipeline and community growth

3. Client Delivery Accountability (The Flywheel)

  • You will partner with client delivery team, hold the team accountable to client campaign delivery: clear owners, timelines, standards, and visibility into every campaign in flight
  • Ensure the community and growth systems feed delivery, so the right creators are activated, ready, and matched when a client campaign needs them
  • Ensure how we connect opportunity to creators is a best in class and standardized experience, ie creators are briefed and supported so every deliverable lands brand-safe and on-strategy
  • Connect delivery outcomes back into growth: campaign results become the proof that attracts the next creators and the next clients, a loop that is designed to flourish
  • Partner with the Recruitics Group B2B marketing team, who lead brand-direct marketing motions, so the creator side and the demand side grow in lockstep

4. Career Creator Network™ Growth

  • Manage and grow the Career Creator Network™, activating and building our owned network of career creators
  • Own creator growth strategy across all creator personas, from acquisition through activation and retention
  • Scout and acquire high-potential creators across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and LinkedIn that align with Jobstream's niche and our clients' needs
  • Pitch the Jobstream™ value proposition clearly, handling objections around commission structures and technical setup
  • Run top-of-funnel brands and channels, including Creator Industry HQ and the newsletter engine, as always-on acquisition layers into Jobstream™

5. Creator Success, Engagement & Retention

  • Own the creator lifecycle from onboarding through long-term retention, building the systems yourself and running them day to day alongside the Creator Community & Growth Manager
  • Ensure new creators reach their first earning milestone fast, with white-glove support for high-value accounts
  • Use creator performance data to identify at-risk creators and breakout potential, and direct early intervention on both
  • Oversee the rituals, programming, and touchpoints (including WorkStream, our recurring co-working sessions) that make the Career Creator Network™ a place creators choose to stay
  • Set the community health metrics that matter and hold the team accountable to them

6. Content Engine & Product Advocacy

  • Run a social and video first content operation: pillars, cadence, channel ownership, and creative standards
  • Treat creator-shared job content as a growth lever within the content strategy
  • Contribute to the product roadmap by relaying and sharing user/creator community or market signals and feedback for CreatorpreneurOS™, the operating system that powers creator growth and success and connects creators to our clients and brands
  • Act as the voice of both creators and employer clients internally, feeding structured insights back to the product team

What Does Success Look Like?

Ultimately, revenue lift driven by flawless campaign delivery, creator growth, and employer relationships that expand.

  • Client Delivery: The team ensures we have the right creator pipeline in the growth acquisition plan and activation/engagement plans to deliver campaigns on time and on brief, with client satisfaction and renewals as proof the flywheel works
  • Fulfillment Capacity: A creator network that meets and exceeds the expectations of the brand-direct offering
  • New Creator Sign-ups: Monthly and quarterly volume of new verified creators
  • Activation Rate: The % of onboarded creators who complete their first earning milestone on Jobstream™, trending up month over month
  • Retention Rate: A strong base of active creators maintained over a 6-month rolling window
  • Community Engagement: WorkStream attendance, participation rates, and creator-to-creator referrals
  • Team Performance: A direct report operating with clear priorities, measurable weekly goals, and visible growth
  • Brand Visibility: Reach, share of voice, and the quality of creators and clients the brand attracts
  • Brand Safety: Zero incidents, known for being the most secure, trusted, quality, business done the right way and for good brand, continuing the inherited legacy of the Hire Innovations portfolio as a market-leader defining new talent categories

What We're Looking For

  • A growth leader who has built and scaled ecommerce and digital businesses, and now brings those playbooks to the creator economy
  • B2B experience with enterprise clients: you are comfortable and understand present, pitch, and build trust with senior stakeholders, and you know how to grow an account after the first win
  • A doer above all: you build the system, ship the work yourself, and hire only for what you genuinely can't do
  • A people leader who develops talent: you set direction, coach, and hold a high standard while giving your team room to own their craft
  • Familiarity and thoughtful about creating brand persona, and exceptional taste and a high standard for brand perception and visual identity. You know what good delivery looks like and how to hold a team accountable to it
